notes.title: Major optimization!
notes.content: [p]Solved the issues of character movement stuttering and rubberbanding under high latency conditions.[/p][p align="start"]Now you can truly enjoy playing LazyClimbers with your friends smoothly! No more worries about network lag!!![/p]

notes.title: v1.3.0 Update: New Checkpoint System!
notes.content:
v1.3.0 Update: New Checkpoint System!  

[h1]Checkpoint Mechanics[/h1]
[list]
[*] Using any Magic Stone now creates a checkpoint  
[*] Access checkpoints via [Teleport] in ESC menu  
[*] Only retains last used Magic Stone's location  
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Optimized multilingual localization  
[*] Fixed miscellaneous bugs  
[/list]

notes.content:
1. Localization BUG fix
2. Optimize the placement of magic platform props in levels
3. Fix the BUG that the six-pointed star part displays incorrectly
4. Optimize the button display for character stuck repair
5. Fix the abnormal display of magic platform

notes.title: 0.3.0 version update!
notes.content:
1. [New Prop]
a. A brand new magic item that can be used interchangeably to obtain an additional and disposable magic platform, which can only be used in non clone states
b. After each pickup, changing the item will enter the charging state, and it will take some time before you can claim a new additional magic platform here again (charging time: 40s)
c. Each player can carry up to one additional magic platform
d. Prop distribution/hidden throughout the map
[img]https://clan.st.dl.eccdnx.com/images/44924287/4416ac41ddd95939450d268abbec7eb4f592cb87.png[/img]
2. [Value] Adjust the CD for creating the magic platform to 5 seconds
3. Performance optimization, frame rate limit, no display frame rate
a. (Old users need to delete the old settings archive, directory as follows: C: \ Users \ username \ AppData \ Local \ pa \ Saved)
4. Bug repair for inability to reconnect after online failure

notes.title: Heavy update! Multi person lobby and new levels!!! My guest, come and play!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Update on Levels![/h1]
[list]
[*] We have updated a brand new level with moderate difficulty, which has more rich gameplay waiting for you to explore! 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924287/02e0135830aab753a5b4a40b66d2d2cc786a62f2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924287/5f707b5c32f627456d29fcade1ae07f1643700fe.png[/img]
[h1]Update on Online Lobby![/h1]
[list]
[*] We have created a new online lobby for multiplayer game mode, now you may search for public rooms in the lobby and join freely!
[/list][list]
[*] If you only want to play with friends and don't want strangers to join, remember to select private when creating room.
[/list]
[h1]Other Gameplay Polishing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now players are capable of removing the magic pad that has been placed, the intention of magic pad is still to let players cooperate and help each other.
[/list][list]
[*] Polished the animation of jumping pad.
[/list][list]
[*] Polished some collisions and climbing angles in levels. 
[/list][list]
[*]Reduced the default BGM volume in the Main Menu.
[/list]
